integrity: The proof uses exact symbolic elimination reduced to a public integer-polynomial certificate. A standard-library verifier checks the defining equations, uniqueness determinant, rational-root exhaustion, and all surviving padded trivial solutions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem closes only the span-12 boundary and does not address span 13 or higher. It also does not exclude a hypothetical nontrivial knot whose Jones polynomial is exactly 1.
title: Span-12 closure for the Jones-polynomial cosmetic-surgery obstruction
